title: Auth
description: Optional. Without it the site is crawled anonymously.

type.title: Type
type.description: yii2-form: a login form with a hidden _csrf field. keycloak: the login URL redirects to a Keycloak login page (fields username and password; the field settings below are ignored).

usernameField.title: Username field
usernameField.description: Name or CSS selector of the username input, e.g. LoginForm[login] or #login-form input[type=email].

passwordField.title: Password field
passwordField.description: Name or CSS selector of the password input, e.g. LoginForm[password] or input[type=password].

password.title: Password
password.description: Stored encrypted and returned masked as "********" (send the mask or omit the key to keep the stored value).

passwordSet.title: Password stored
passwordSet.description: Whether a password is stored; read only.

removePassword.title: Remove password
removePassword.description: Deletes the stored password on save.
